name: Mission
overview: Scripture reveals mission as the divine calling to proclaim God's glory and salvation to all nations, fulfilling the mandate to make disciples and spread the gospel worldwide. From Isaiah's willing response to God's call to send laborers, to the beautiful imagery of those who bring good news and peace, the Bible emphasizes the urgency and privilege of mission work. Jesus commands His followers to teach and baptize all nations, underscoring the global scope of the gospel before the end comes. The mission is both a declaration of God's reign and an essential witness among all peoples.
